summary_text: On this weekend, the user purchased Amul Taaza Pasteurised Toned Milk (500 ml) during the evening. It is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for the Amul brand, a specific preference for evening shopping, or a routine purchase pattern. No other brands or dayparts have been observed to determine dominance or habit.
